name: Mistral API Free mode
amount: Included monthly usage within per-model limits shown in your Mistral account (not published)
summary: Mistral's Free mode: API keys with no credit card, covering its smaller models (Ministral, Codestral, Voxtral) within per-minute limits. The bigger models (Mistral Small, Mistral Medium) have a free limit of 0. Mistral may use Free-mode inputs and outputs to train its models. The free models are in the directory and tested daily.
source_note: docs.mistral.ai (Activate Studio; Usage and limits) and help.mistral.ai (data use in Free mode), plus our own requests with a Free-mode key, 2026-09-29.
